notes: Also on the Boston page: Teen Empowerment Studios, a youth-run music and performance arts group, with its own application link. Another program, Visions for the Future, is for ages 17 to 24. Hiring dates are not posted, so ask TE.
name: Teen Empowerment Youth Organizer
what_you_do: Youth Organizing Program with two Boston sites. The work is with community and municipal partners on violence prevention and youth development. The page does not list the day-to-day tasks for youth organizers.
who_can_apply: Youth ages 14 to 19. Boston sites are in the Warren Gardens area of Roxbury and the Howard-Dacia area of Dorchester.
pay_detail: The site says TE employs youth. Pay rate not stated.
deadline_text: No dates posted. The page has a Boston Youth Job Interest Form.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Boston Youth Job Interest Form on the Youth Employment page, or use the Apply to work as a Youth Organizer link on the Boston page.
